description: Default permissions plus the webview-window creation surface the pop-out buttons need (terminal drawer in chat → term-*; artifact detail → art-*). The globs cover every spawned window without needing per-id capability entries. The http:default allow-list covers loopback (dev), the *.ht.local cluster ingresses (search / images / ai), the 192.168.8.0/24 LAN (titan + NodePort services), and the 100.0.0.0/8 Tailscale range (Android APK reaches the cluster via tailnet). HT is a trusted-LAN product; broad globs prevent 'Command plugin:http|fetch not allowed by ACL' surprises every time a new cluster service comes online.
